title: Obsidian Sync Conflict Count
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:sync
| stats count(eval(status="conflict")) as sync_conflicts by vault
| where sync_conflicts>0
| sort - sync_conflicts
description: Uses Obsidian Sync logs telemetry to monitor how often vault syncs end in conflicts in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for notes that need manual cleanup before they fork further, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Obsidian Sync logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how often vault syncs end in conflicts so you can spot notes that need manual cleanup before they fork further before it becomes annoying.
